references.text: The institution of circumcision as a sign of the covenant between God and Abraham, with Abraham himself being circumcised as part of this covenant.
Abraham's age of 99 years is mentioned here when the Lord appears to him and establishes the covenant.
Isaac, Abraham's son, is circumcised on the eighth day, in accordance with God's command to Abraham.
Stephen refers to Abraham and circumcision in his speech, pointing to God's covenant with Abraham.
Paul discusses the significance of circumcision and Abraham's faith before circumcision as part of his argument for justification by faith.
